subject: Checking econ owner nomination and security onramp
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Alex Murray <alex.murray@vellum.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Checking econ owner nomination and security onramp

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

1) Quick recap
- Vellum Labs is evaluating Redwood to replace an in-house LLM inference layer for document ingestion and real-time summarization. Primary success metrics: 40% reduction in token spend and sub-200ms median tail latency for 1k concurrent users.
- Main technical blockers: SSO, SOC2 evidence, and procurement cadence for SaaS contracts.

2) Who we've heard today (helpful to confirm)
- Economic / budget owner: you mentioned a finance lead who signs pilots — can you confirm the name?
- Procurement / legal: appears to be a separate procurement team who will require a standard procurement packet and PO.
- Security: you mentioned an IT security reviewer for SOC2 / data flows.

3) Asks / next steps (goal: get to a mutual action plan)
- Please confirm the econ/budget owner so we can route pricing and approval language correctly (we typically send a 60-day pilot quote to the budget owner + procurement).
- Please share the security reviewer name/email (we can provide SOC2 Type II and a short security checklist pre-populated for your team).
- We'll attach a draft SOW and a lightweight procurement packet for initial review (see attachments).
- Proposed: 30-min procurement + security intro on Wed, Jul 24 between 10–12 PDT. If that works, we’ll send a calendar invite with agenda and owners.

Attachments: redwood-security-checklist.xlsx (stub), vellum-pilot-sow-draft.pdf (draft SOW)

Workstream owner: Logan Wright (deal contact)
If easier, reply with short answers inline and we’ll update the mutual action plan.

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Murray <alex.murray@vellum.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@vellum.ai>, Rina Kapoor <rina.kapoor@vellum.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Jul 2028 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checking econ owner nomination and security onramp

Thanks Logan — good notes and appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers inline: 

> - Please confirm the econ/budget owner so we can route pricing and approval language correctly

We're nominating Sanjay Patel (cc'd) as the budget owner for this pilot. He owns vendor approvals for experiments under $200k.

> - Please share the security reviewer name/email (we can provide SOC2 Type II and a short security checklist pre-populated for your team).

Rina Kapoor (cc'd) is our security reviewer — she'll want the SOC2 Type II and a network/data-flow diagram.

> Proposed: 30-min procurement + security intro on Wed, Jul 24 between 10–12 PDT.

Sanjay and Rina can do Jul 24 at 10:30 PDT.

Also: two quick asks from our side — can you provide a short summary of pilot success criteria (what counts as "success" for the 60-day pilot) and a high-level pricing sheet for the pilot (token caps, overage rates, and billing terms)? We’ll need that for internal approval.

Thanks,
Alex Murray
Head of Data Products, Vellum Labs
alex.murray@vellum.ai

Perfect — thanks for the quick turn, Alex. Looping in below are the concrete items Redwood will provide ahead of the Wed 10:30 PDT intro: 

1) Security artifacts (attached / links)- SOC2 Type II report (redacted) — https://redwood.inference.com/soc2/V2-report 
- Network & data flow diagram (attached in procurement-packet.zip)
- Pre-filled security checklist (attached: redwood-security-checklist.xlsx)

2) Pilot success criteria (proposed)- Latency: median tail <200ms for target API routes
- Cost: token spend <= negotiated pilot cap (we'll include a dashboard for daily burn)
- Quality: generated summaries pass 85% of spot checks by your product team

3) Pilot pricing (proposed)- 60-day pilot: $8,500 flat fee + usage up to 5M tokens included; overage $0.0006/token
- Optional 14-day extension at pro-rated rate
- Billing: Net30 (standard) — we can support Net45 for enterprise agreements, please flag if needed

4) Procurement packet & next steps- Attached: procurement-packet.zip (contains draft MSA language, insurance cert, and SOW)
- DocuSign pilot agreement link: https://docusign.com/XYZ-pilot-agreement (we'll generate once terms are agreed)
- Proposed meeting: Wed, Jul 24, 10:30–11:00 PDT. Agenda: introductions, security Qs, procurement lead next actions, confirm pilot KPIs.

If Sanjay and Rina agree, Monica (cc) from our onboarding team will attend the intro call to kick off technical onboarding and pilot instrumentation. Priyom is our solutions lead on quantization/batching — he'll be available for the technical deep-dive post-Intro.

Attachments: procurement-packet.zip, redwood-security-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll send the calendar invite once I see confirmation.

—Logan
